highspeed_nodrag1833: Bastian Nodrag introduced himself as a tailor from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A bullet went through Bastian Nodrag's sleeve at R-F3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).
Bastian Nodrag's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
lebronmygoat25: At the depot, Quentin Lebronmygoat had practised answering to his name. At R-S10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
A shell hit the latrine at R-S10. Nobody was hurt. Quentin Lebronmygoat says it was the best day of the war.
